Perform ONE SINGLE fluid Chun-Li-style SF6 crouching medium kick across the clip (one kick only, never twice), pure body motion in empty air: NEVER rise or stand up—keep hips and head strictly low at crouch height throughout the entire wind-up, kick, and recovery. she shifts smoothly onto her low bent support leg and extends ONE long, graceful Wushu low split-kick far straight forward along the ground baseline (kicking leg stretched fully straight right just above the floor, torso balanced low with arms poised); brief apex hold at full reach, then smooth retraction back into the starting kneeling crouch guard pose.
